title: Normalize string input for Codex Responses
description: Codex upstream rejects public OpenAI Responses string input with 'Input must be a list'. Add normalization so /v1/responses accepts string input and converts it to a user input_text item before forwarding to Codex, preserving existing array input behavior.
close_reason: Normalized Codex Responses string input to a user input_text array while preserving array input behavior; verified focused tests, build, and full suite.

title: Add local Docker build smoke test workflow

title: Optimize Dockerfile runtime image
description: Reduce Docker runtime image size and attack surface: use reproducible npm install with package-lock.json, avoid shipping dev dependencies, add a .dockerignore, and run the app as a non-root user where feasible.
close_reason: Optimized Docker build to use npm ci from package-lock.json, copy only production dependencies into the runtime image, exclude unnecessary build context with .dockerignore, and run as the node user with writable /data and /config directories. Verified with npm run build and docker image checks.
